epic.title: MBG Monitor UI Improvements
epic.description: Simplify news display, refactor sidebar, create favicon, focus on MBG poisoning incidents

subtasks.title: Sidebar Layout & Filter Refactor
subtasks.description: Refactor Sidebar.jsx to fix overlapping filter tabs. Tidy up the layout so filters don't overlap. Reduce number of filter categories shown. Use a more compact horizontal scrollable design or dropdown for filter selection.

subtasks.title: Map View Legend & Overlay Simplification
subtasks.description: Modify MapView.jsx: 1) Hide the 'Jenis Insiden' legend on bottom right (remove the entire legend div). 2) Simplify overlay panels to only show 2 numbers: total incidents and total poisoning (keracunan) cases. Remove or reduce the victims count overlay.

subtasks.title: AI Summary TLDR Optimization
subtasks.description: Modify worker/src/ai.js to produce much shorter summaries (1 sentence max, ~50-80 chars). Update the Gemini prompt to emphasize brevity: 'Write a ONE sentence summary in Indonesian, max 80 characters. Focus on key facts: what happened, where, how many victims.'

subtasks.title: Create MBG Monitor Favicon
subtasks.description: Create an SVG favicon representing MBG monitoring - a bento box or warning/alert icon in red/dark theme. Add the favicon to frontend/index.html. Create the SVG file in frontend/public/ directory.

subtasks.title: Focus on MBG Poisoning Data
subtasks.description: Modify data filtering to focus on MBG poisoning (keracunan) incidents only. In useIncidents.js, filter out non-MBG poisoning categories. Update constants.js to simplify category list. Add a relevance filter that checks for MBG/school context keywords.
